plan.title: Reorder sheet fields by drag and drop

steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen for an RFQ template sheet.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.
Configure the event with an RFQ stage.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ template so its sheet fields render.
Add a line item so the pricing sheet is populated.
Render and populate the template-backed sheet before reordering fields.
Confirm that the sheet has multiple observable fields to reorder.
Reorder the Price field before Product using the available drag-and-drop operation.
Verify that the sheet header order reflects the drop position.
